<sub>History: the previous seat, `session_01Rerax7QTjKMPCUZxQUtPFR` (`marchtian`), ran the cutover batch of objectstack-ai/objectstack#22601 → B and stood down at 6186498514. Its delegation record is in this body's revisions before 2026-10-18. Live card states are in this seat's status comment, not in the body.</sub>

## Delegation record

**Delegated to this session:** every open card of this tree. The seat put its plan to the maintainer in this session's chat, and the maintainer chose the seat's recommended option on each of its four questions:
1. **Scope:** every open card of the tree joins the epic lane (`pm:epic`). C8's spec stage (8e) is dispatched by this seat and reviewed at the contract tier.
2. **C11 splits:** objectstack-ai/objectstack#15214's open-source documentation lands after C8; its cloud half stays with objectstack-ai/cloud#1979.
3. **Back ends:** build stages go to cloud sessions; read-only censuses and measurements run as in-session subagents.
4. **Order and width**, amended twice by the maintainer in this session's chat: 「还是按照关键路径顺序来吧。并发不要超过3」, then 「并发开到5会加速你的进程吧，但是尽量不要提前做后续的开发，否则要不停的合并更新。」. So:
   - at most five subagents and cloud sessions are in flight at once;
   - a stage is dispatched only when every predecessor has merged into `main` and its file surface does not meet in-flight work. No stage is built ahead.
   - 8a and 8b follow C2/C3's closure and 8-M's cut (their files do not meet stage 9's); 8c waits on 9a, 8a and 8b; 8e waits on 9b, 8c and 8d; C11 waits on C8.

**Reserved with `pm:epic`:** objectstack-ai/objectstack#15196 (C2), objectstack-ai/objectstack#15204 (C3), objectstack-ai/objectstack#23952 (C3 stage 9), objectstack-ai/objectstack#15212 (C8), objectstack-ai/objectstack#14570, objectstack-ai/objectstack#15831 and objectstack-ai/objectstack#23256 (C8's effects), objectstack-ai/objectstack#11979, objectstack-ai/objectstack#14491, objectstack-ai/objectstack#15214 (C11), and objectstack-ai/objectui#7611 (C9's remainder). Other seats do not claim, dispatch or re-route them while this record stands.

**The plan:**
- **Wave 0:** a closure census of objectstack-ai/objectstack#15196, objectstack-ai/objectstack#15204 and objectstack-ai/objectstack#11979 against `main`. Each closes on evidence. Closing objectstack-ai/objectstack#15196 and objectstack-ai/objectstack#15204 unblocks C8, objectstack-ai/objectstack#14491 and C9's item 3.
- **Wave 1:** stage 9 (#23952). It measures first, then lands as 9a and 9b:

  - 9b: the ceremony rewrites `sys_record_share.source_id` to the rule's name, then deletes the `declared-rule-mirrors` rows.
- **Wave 2:** C8 (#15212). It measures first (8-M); 8-M's measurement fixes the cut. The expected stages:
  - 8a: one tenant predicate, threaded to Layer 0 and to every driver;
  - 8b: every system insert is stamped;
  - 8c: the NULL arms retire, and the chokepoint gate flips;
  - 8d: `GLOBAL_TENANT` and ADR-0120 D3's `COALESCE` retire;
  - 8e: `NOT NULL` per cleared table (protocol 18);
  - test-rewrite PRs, each after the code PR it follows.
- **Wave 3:** C9's remainder and the `.objectui-sha` move that follows it, C11's open-source half, the F1 re-test before the GA cut, and this card's close-out.

**Declared file territory.** Read on objectstack `origin/main` `68a090f`, at region level. C8's regions are refined by 8-M's census.
- **Stage 9:**
  - `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/`: `sharing-rule-service.ts`, `bootstrap-declared-sharing-rules.ts`, and the boot region of `sharing-plugin.ts`;
  - `packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-inventory.ts` (the `sys_sharing_rule` departure and `DECLARED_SHARING_RULE_SEEDER_RUNS`) and `organization-ownership-apply.ts` (mirror deletion and the `source_id` rewrite), with their tests;
  - `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack-seeder-declaration-copy.test.ts`; possibly `packages/core/src/security/security-catalog.ts`.
- **C8:**
  - the engine's tenant derivation and system-insert stamping in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, and `packages/objectql/src/tenancy/platform-object-tenancy.ts`;
  - `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/tenant-layer.ts`;
  - the driver tenant scope: `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts` (`applyTenantScope`) and `driver-turso`;
  - `scripts/check-tenant-chokepoint.mjs`;
  - the NULL-organization readings objectstack-ai/objectstack#15212 names (`resolve-authz-context.ts`, `sharing-rule-service.ts`'s `adminOrgScope`, `settings-service.ts`, `meta-write-org-scope.ts`, `bootstrap-system-capabilities.ts`), the `GLOBAL_TENANT` and `COALESCE` sites, and the DDL that emits `NOT NULL` (8e).
- **C9:** the objectui reader list on objectstack-ai/objectui#7611, and objectstack's `.objectui-sha`.
- **C11:** the `content/docs` tenancy and permissions pages, and the driver docblock.

Why the territory is this wide: C8's subject is the one tenant predicate that every read and write passes through, so its territory is that predicate's measured surface. A card from another lane whose fix lands in one of these regions: comment here, and this session names the stage it serializes behind. The territory is declared, not a lock; the merge queue backstops any collision.

**Close-out:** when every reserved card is closed, this session posts a summary here, removes `pm:epic`, and marks the territory done.

Execution tree for **ADR-0131 — Total organization ownership: no NULL `organization_id`** (`docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md`, merged via objectstack-ai/objectstack#14976, approved by the maintainer 2026-09-04). §8 of the record is the table these cards are cut from.

## The three sentences every card in this tree assumes

1. **A managed package's metadata is not in the database.** It is cross-tenant, it upgrades with the code, and its *definitions* are sealed. A customer's customization is environment-level state: overlay for presentational types, disable-and-clone for behavioural ones, extend for structural ones (ADR-0126's three regimes, now at environment scope only). Environment metadata written by Studio, by the cloud build agent, or by a template-mode install lives in the database, is editable in the UI, and its ledger **has no organization column**. A template package cannot be installed on a shared-database multi-tenant deployment.
2. **A row with an organization column was written by that organization** — created, cloned, or assigned. The column is `NOT NULL`. References to declared items are **by machine name**, resolved registry-first.
3. **A table with no organization column is deployment-level or code-level.** It is protected by permissions, not by the tenant wall.

## Dependency order

```
objectstack-ai/objectstack#15193 (gate: v18 line opens)
  └─ this epic
       ├─ C1  Default Organization load-bearing; unstamped write refused in every posture
       ├─ C2  catalog read from the registry; assignments reference by name
       │        └─ C3  retire the catalog seeders, the per-org catalog machinery, the four objects
       │        └─ C9  (objectui) Setup reads the registry; assignment pages stay data pages
       ├─ C4  email/notification templates resolve the registry; org-level editing closed
       ├─ C5  `sys_metadata` family tenant-less; per-org overlay axis retired; managed content sealed
       │        └─ C12 the template install mode
       ├─ C6  deployment-level state has no organization column
       │        └─ C10 (cloud) control plane adopts D7, backfill to fates
       ├─ C7  inventory + migration: four fates, manual operator ceremony  (needs C2–C6)
       │        └─ C8  `organization_id` NOT NULL; one predicate; both arms retired  (protocol 18)
       └─ C11 docs and family close-out  (needs C8 + C10)
```

## Staging (D14)

Maintainer, 2026-09-04: 「我发 17.3，然后后续这么大的改动应该放到 v18」 and 「我建议18.0 的主要考虑是客户数据变化比较大，而且需要手工执行升级脚本」.

Two cards landed **before** the 17.3 tag and are not part of this tree: **#15024** (`sys_metadata_activation` ships tenant-less, PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#15155) and **#15030** (the NULL-inclusive business-unit screen of objectstack-ai/objectstack#14949 reverted, PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#15078). ⛔ Everything else is one major with one migration. No 17.x card narrows or removes a driver arm, adds a name column beside an id column, or ships half of this record.

## Open questions the record leaves to the maintainer

ADR-0131 §6 Q1 — what becomes of email-template rows an organization has already customized (`customized: true`): kept readable as the Default Organization's overrides, or dropped with a release note. **To be ruled when C4 is cut**, not before.
